title: Northstar generation closure record v1
description: Explicit, repository-verifiable closure authority for one generation, committed at .northstar/lifecycle/v1/generations/gNN.closure.json. Absence of the record leaves the generation open; an exhausted runway is planning_required, not closure. The tasks digest pins the exact terminal record set the closure covers, so compaction refuses missing, open, stale, mismatched, or ambiguous authority. Complete is never a generation disposition.

tasks_digest.description: Digest of the sorted terminal task summaries the closure covers, as printed by the tasks-digest command. Compaction recomputes it and refuses any drift.

preservation_evidence.description: Optional reference to the preservation oracle output (promoted authority, rehomed commitments, selected evidence) that authorized the closure.
